name: Portico
description: Little classical temple fronts in rows: a pediment with a round light, four columns and a three-stepped base, in marble, stone and painted stucco.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--pp); clip-path: @var(--pp); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(4.5% 4.5% at 50% 25%, transparent 100%, #000 100%); mask: radial-gradient(4.5% 4.5% at 50% 25%, transparent 100%, #000 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color6)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--pb); clip-path: @var(--pb); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
